text: Special Situations Your employer has moved. Even if your employer has moved to an address that's different from your W-2, tell us the address that's on the W-2. If you don't, and you e-file, your refund could be delayed. You can't fit the address into the field. We need your employer's address for e-filing. Type in as much as you can, exactly as it appears on your W-2, and your return will be accepted. If you're planning to e-file, you shouldn't try to abbreviate the address. Doing so will create a discrepancy.
